### Highlights

#### 🔌 The League Client is found on current Windows builds
Some people never got past "Connecting", however many times they reinstalled.

- Finding the League Client no longer depends on `wmic`, a Windows tool that Windows 11 24H2 removed. Without it, League RPC could not read the client's port and waited forever, showing "Launching League..." on Discord and nothing else.
- When the client genuinely cannot be reached, the sidebar now says so after 45 seconds instead of showing "Connecting" indefinitely, and the reason goes into the log where a bug report can pick it up.
- A League Client that crashed and left stale connection details behind no longer stops League RPC from finding the client that is actually running.

### Bug Fixes

- Turning on Debug Mode could stop League RPC connecting to the League Client altogether. Its log files also went next to the program rather than into the app's own log folder.
